line_text: Brutal is the first song of the record but the last song I wrote if that makes any sense it is really weird intense which I love Dan I wrote it together about two weeks before we had to to turn in the album The day we wrote it we went on a drive to go get lunch take a break from the studio As we drove around Dan played me some of his fav 90s grunge songs I looove 90s grunge I told him I wanted to write a song like the ones he was playing me so when we got back to the studio he came up with this really simple sick riff we wrote brutal The day before I over heard someone talk about how brutal the entertainment industry was I remember thinking the word was so interesting descriptive I love brutality honest borderline pathetic lyrics so we tried to do that in the verses it is one of my favs songs on the record I really hope you like it

title: SOUR Diary “Journal / Zine”
line_text: 2 traitor

title: SOUR Diary “Journal / Zine”
line_text: I wrote most of traitor on my bedroom floor in Salt Lake City I sort of forgot about it until I sent a bunch of voice memos to Dan he said he liked this one We finished it up together I really like the way it turned out It sort of feels like and old country song to me which I am obsessed with

title: SOUR Diary “Journal / Zine”
line_text: 3 drivers license

title: SOUR Diary “Journal / Zine”
line_text: my first real published song I literally still cannot believe how big it got Super grateful for everyone who listened I have talked about how drivers license came to be in like every interview I have ever done so I will spare you guys the boring details

title: SOUR Diary “Journal / Zine”
line_text: 4 1 step forward 3 steps back

title: SOUR Diary “Journal / Zine”
line_text: I wrote this song in like March of 2020 The day I wrote it my mom and I were doing a roadtrip from LA to Salt Lake City I was obsessed with Taylor Swifts reputation then and we literally played the whole album over over the entire 10 hour car drive I have the best mom ever haha During that same trip I got a text from someone who was telling me something about their diet or productivity they described their progress as always one step forward and three steps back I had never really heard anyone use that phrase before I thought it was super cool when I got home I decided to take that phrase write a song over the stunning chords in New Years Day When it came time to put out the album Jack Antonoff Taylor Swift who wrote New Years Day aka my favorite love song of all time were kind enough to approve my reimagining

title: SOUR Diary “Journal / Zine”
line_text: 5 deja vu

title: SOUR Diary “Journal / Zine”
line_text: deja vu was the most stubborn song I have ever made lol It took Dan me soo long to get the mix to a good place We wrote it about a month after we made drivers license and I really liked its unique sound I am also literally obsessed with the music video for it An amazing woman named Allie Avital directed it my friend Talia Ryder stared in it with me It was soo much fun

title: SOUR Diary “Journal / Zine”
line_text: 6 good 4 you

title: SOUR Diary “Journal / Zine”
line_text: Good 4 you is my favorite song on the record I struggled for a really long time to write upbeat songs because I thought in order to write them I had to talk about being happy or being in love When I was writing this album I was not really feeling any of those joyous feelings lol good 4 you perfectly captures my feelings of heartbreak in a way that feels really fun I listen to it while I am driving sometimes it feels sort of energizing I am super stoked to play it live one day eek

title: SOUR Diary “Journal / Zine”
line_text: 7 enough for you

title: SOUR Diary “Journal / Zine”
line_text: I wrote enough for you entirely by myself which I am really proud of I think its probably the best song I have ever written currently I really love not only the honesty vulnerability in it but the hope In an album full of sad breakup songs this songs feels like a light at the end of the tunnel a promise that the feeling would not be forever The entire song is really just my voice an acoustic guitar which I think is sick

title: SOUR Diary “Journal / Zine”
line_text: 8 happier

title: SOUR Diary “Journal / Zine”
line_text: happier was the first song I wrote on this record well I supposed I did not know I was ever going to get to make a record then but nonetheless funnily enough I actually wrote it in between takes of this super poppy dance number in a show I was filming which is so ironic It was one of those songs that the universe gives to people like magic It felt like the entire song was fully formed floating I was just a channel it used to come to life Woah I sound so fake deep I am so sorry lol No but its true it was a really magical experience And what is even cooler than that is the fact that this is the song that connected me my fav colaborator Dan He saw a video of this song I posted on Instagram DMed me the rest is history

title: SOUR Diary “Journal / Zine”
line_text: 9 jealousy jealousy

title: SOUR Diary “Journal / Zine”
line_text: I wrote jealousy jealousy with Casey Smith in summer 2020 I was obsessed with bass driven songs really wanted to make one of my own We wrote it about the pressures of social media the terrible insecurity that comes with it Growing up on the internet has completely distorted my reality in many occasions I wrote this song during a time where it was hard to not only separate other peoples real life from their social media but my own life from my social media if that makes any sense Writing this song was really cathartic for me I hope other people can relate to it in some way

title: SOUR Diary “Journal / Zine”
line_text: 10 favorite crime

title: SOUR Diary “Journal / Zine”
line_text: Dan I wrote favorite crime sometime last summer I think I had know I loved you so bad I let you treat me like that written in my notes app for a while it sort of sparked the entire song I really love how the song is one big metaphor Figurative language was something I had to work on in my songwriting I am a very literal specific writer similes are not often where my brain tends to go so I am super proud of this song

title: SOUR Diary “Journal / Zine”
line_text: 11 hope you are ok

title: SOUR Diary “Journal / Zine”
line_text: hope you are ok is the last song on the record It is a super special song to me I love the stories it tells I wrote most of it in my living room in early 2020 drawing inspiration from some of my favorites country folk artists I think my favorite lines I have ever written are hope he took his bad deal made a royal flush hope you know how proud I am you were created with the courage to unlearn all of their hatred I had so much fun making it I hope it gives optimism to someone out there just like it did for me

title: GUTS [Liner Notes]

title: Olivia Rodrigo - A Short Film (Vevo LIFT)
line_text: I spend a lot of time by myself I come up with my best ideas when I am like truly alone and I think that is sort of why I fell in love with songwriting I have always been a super emotional I have always felt things really deeply so writing has really been a way for me to sort of process those emotions and make them a little less confusing Things become so much clearer when you write them down become so much more manageable when you can sort of look at them on a paper or hear it in a song Crеating SOUR was exactly that experiеnce I really used it as a way to process so many uncomfortable emotions and so many emotions that are not really publicly fun or acceptable to express jealousy and anger and like spite and I think there would not be no way for me to like express that any other way except for songwriting

title: Olivia Rodrigo - A Short Film (Vevo LIFT)
line_text: Making music has really taught me how to have confidence in my point of view and my choices drivers license is such a my heart on a silver platter song and all of my favourite artist said this once you make a song you have to sort of disassociate yourself from it and be like okay it is the worlds now and the world can project whatever they want to on it and the only thing you can do is write a song that resonates with you I am never going to sacrifice writing truthful authentic personal songs for fear of what a couple people on the internet are going to say

title: Olivia Rodrigo - A Short Film (Vevo LIFT)
line_text: I am so not the girl that I was when I wrote SOUR I remember writing it and being so sad and so insecure I have moments all the time where I will just like remember where I was and how I was feeling and I am just like so far from that now and I am so proud of that When drivers license came out I remember driving around listening to that song and driving on these streets that I remember driving down being so sad and unsure of myself listening to a song that I had made and feeling so empowered for the first time

title: Olivia Rodrigo - A Short Film (Vevo LIFT)
line_text: Growing up never really scared me I always get really excited by the though of getting older It is cool to look back and see how much you have grown and I just love figuring out more about myself and about the world coming into my own more and i feel that is a product of growing up so why would I be scared of that
